描述_EN: A mirror with a bare frame, with the inner part made slightly higher. Although many plain mirrors were also found in China during the Song Dynasty (960-1279), the eight-flowered shape of mirrors such as this one is not known to be a mirror style unique to the Goryeo Dynasty. It may have been mass-produced for funerary purposes, especially since it is often found as a secondary burial object in tombs of this period.
描述_ZN: 一面裸框的镜子，内侧部分做得略高。 虽然中国在宋代（960-1279）也发现了许多素面镜，但像这面镜子的八花形并不出名，是高丽王朝特有的镜子风格。 它可能是为丧葬目的而大量生产的，特别是在这一时期的墓葬中经常发现它作为次要的随葬品。
